author_note: Independent blind corpus written from SPEC-changeimpact.md and the owner brief TZ-01 only; no HTML/JS of the tool was read. Written against spec rev 2026-10-02.1 and revised against rev 2026-10-02.2 on 2026-10-02: every rev .1 case was re-checked against rev .2 (no existing expectation changed; any change would be recorded in a per-case "correction" field) and cases prefixed r2_ were added for the clarifications of rev .2 §12. Expectations were derived from the specification text by hand and cross-checked against a small spec-only restatement of the rules written by the corpus author (not derived from the tool). The key gap_classification ([area, issue, classification] present among closure gaps) is an extension of the §11 format for the rev .2 §7 rule that a gap carries the row effective classification.
reference: Rule-matrix corpus for the Design Change Impact Mapper 2.0: the three owner presets of TZ-01 (identical replacement as a replacement-in-kind candidate whose review obligations remain, pump retrofit with hydraulics/power/interface/document/test areas, temporary jumper with unknown safety effect and open return obligations); every screening row including like_for_like failing each of its four conditions; family seeds, rules R01-R45 and the emergency/temporary process rules with max-rank interaction; two-pass propagation with attenuation, depth cap, cycle termination and edge provenance (built-in vs custom), hand-counted edge totals; the eight ordered closure checks, explicit evidence statuses, overrides and the rule that an unknown interface cannot be closed as unknown; every input gap and parameter gap with near-misses, locale number formats, invalid dates and every range form; the three independent states with approval binding and staleness; restore of invalid imported states; and the blank state.
tolerance: exact categorical match; every expect key is one graded check (classification/absent/levels/issues/no_issues/gap_ids/no_gap_ids/edges/restore_notes per entry); issues, gap_ids, edges and restore_notes are membership checks (listed items must be present, other items may also be present); edge fields given must match exactly; edge_count and closed_count are exact integers.
not_benchmarked: Several valid override rows on one area with different classifications (rev .2 does not say which wins).
Numbers with a single separator followed by exactly three digits that cannot be a thousands group, e.g. 0.125 or 1234.567: the literal rev .2 §8 wording refuses them as ambiguous; not asserted.
Hyphen ranges whose bounds contain an exponent (e.g. 1e-3-5).
Whether a review row with an unrecognised status value or an unknown classification value is accepted or reported under restore.
Absence of a field from restore_notes (format only checks presence), e.g. parameters:null not named.
Unit-list notices (never gaps) and the content of human-readable reasons, paths and notices.
Fingerprint key-order independence (not expressible in this corpus format).
Learn mode, presets UI, PDF, Python export, localisation, project-package integration.
